Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you. I've read the brief: I'm your TA agent for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez, and I'll look after your calendar and messages.

Briefly, what else I can do:
- **Web app** (this chat) — https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca. From a phone or computer on the same network: first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats, files, the screen and voice here.
- **Own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Own accounts** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help with a captcha or phone check.
- **Other** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
